measures.title: Crandall Library Budget, City of Glens Falls
measures.summary: Asks City of Glens Falls voters to approve the proposed 2027 budget of the Crandall Public Library District, which totals $6,186,608 and is partly funded by the municipalities in the Library District. The share to be raised by a property tax on real property in the City of Glens Falls is $941,030.
measures.yesMeans: The Crandall Public Library District's proposed 2027 budget is approved, including the $941,030 share raised from Glens Falls property.
measures.noMeans: The Crandall Public Library District's proposed 2027 budget is not approved by Glens Falls voters.
